interpretation: The compact return graph does not retain the tested build-only group/name/dependency containers. This is a structural identity result, not a retained-byte measurement or guarantee of when GC runs.

The helper frame ends before checking begins; the verifier loop no longer explicitly roots the original groups or by-key full group records. Intentional group keys and member ConstantInfo identities remain borrowed.
Construction peak, whole-checker RSS, GC time and hosted frontend speed were not measured or compared. No claim that these containers dominate a live campaign heap is made.
The prior reverse-edge allocation patch and its synthetic allocation record remain separate; this slice only changes build-data reachability during checking.

A later authenticated campaign needs a fresh selected-byte consumer digest/capture and constructor gate. The existing imported-kernel substitution profile applies without a new compatibility exception; no frozen live process is modified.
